mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where FEDFUNDS declines over 3 months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5% for two consecutive months, it signals restrictive monetary policy that compresses corporate earnings growth, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where FEDFUNDS > 4.5% for 2 consecutive months, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in housing starts (HOUST) and declines in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signal robust aggregate demand and labor market tightness, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods with HOUST increases and UNRATE declines, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: In a low-unemployment regime (UNRATE < 4.0%), a further decline in unemployment signals accelerating wage pressures that increase corporate costs, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods with UNRATE < 4.0% and declining unemployment, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A rising trend in industrial production (INDPRO) over the past 3 months indicates expanding manufacturing output that supports corporate earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods with INDPRO increases over 3 months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) exceed 1,350,000 units for two consecutive months, it signals robust residential construction that boosts consumer confidence and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods with HOUST > 1350 for 2 consecutive months, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in inflation (CPIAUCSL) and federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signal aggressive monetary policy response to inflation, reducing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods with CPIAUCSL increases and FEDFUNDS rises, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-growth demand regime (GDPC1 growth rate > 2.5% annualized), a decline in real sector financial assets (RSAFS) signals weakening consumer spending, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods with GDPC1 growth > 2.5% annualized and RSAFS declines, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.
